__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A cute little blue smurf with a white hat and white boots.  You have a sudden
urge to crush him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A smurf is singing and walking along.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle smurf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A small smurf is quietly picking berries.  He seems to hardly notice you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A smurf is here, picking berries.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle smurf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Brainy Smurf has on his usual glasses.  Brainy Smurf isn't liked much by the
other smurfs.  They fear his knowledge.  Knowledge is power!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Brainy Smurf is here, mumbling something to himself.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle brainy smurf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Handy is always building something.  He never takes a break.  Why don't you
give him a break, like all of his bones.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Handy Smurf is building something here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle handy smurf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Sleepy never gets enough sleep.  You would think he goes to college.  I wonder
if he has ever stayed up a whole night without sleeping.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Sleepy Smurf is sleep walking here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle sleepy smurf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Hefty is a total health nut.  He lifts weights, eats right, and exercises all
the time.  Won't do him much good when he's DEAD.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Hefty Smurf is lifting weights here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hefty smurf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Grumpy has never been happy in his whole life.  So why don't you just end it?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle grumpy smurf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Jokey loves to give people presents.  Too bad the present explodes when opened.
Oh well, to each his own.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Jokey Smurf is here, holding a present.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle jokey smurf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Smurfette is the cutest little smurf you've ever seen.  If only she were your
size.  I wonder how much she charges the other smurfs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle smurfette

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Yep, its Papa Smurf all right.  Red hat and boots and the funny little white
beard.  Papa Smurf treats his fellow smurfs with dignity and respect.  That
is why Papa Smurf is so popular among the ladies.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Papa Smurf is practicing magic here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle papa smurf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Gargamel has never done anything right in his life.  He has caught smurfs
before but always lets them escape.  He brings true meaning to the word moron.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Gargamel is here, cursing out the smurfs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle gargamel

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Gargamel's worthless cat.  He is just about as dumb as Gargamel.  He should
just grab a smurf in his teeth and chew away.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle azreal cat
